win.list_av: powershell Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/SecurityCenter2 -ClassName AntivirusProduct ^| Select-Object displayName
win.list_startup: powershell Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand ^| Select-Object Name, Command, Location
win.list_ports: powershell Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen ^| Sort-Object LocalPort ^| Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess
win.list_ip: powershell Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 ^| Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress
win.pkill: wmic process where name='<process_name>' call terminate
win.os_info: powershell Get-ComputerInfo ^| Select-Object WindowsProductName, WindowsVersion, OsHardwareAbstractionLayer
win.list_services: powershell Get-Service ^| Sort-Object Status,DisplayName ^| Select-Object Status,Name,DisplayName
win.list_users: powershell Get-LocalUser ^| Select-Object Name, Enabled, LastLogon
